construct.note: Upstream reads `set d to new Date()` as `set d to new` (an unset variable) and a second command, `Date()`. With a class (`new Map()`) or a call after it (`new Date().getDay()`) that fails when run; with a constructor that is also a function (`Date`) and nothing after it that needs d, it runs, and d is null.

claims.source: on click put new Date(2020, 0, 15).getFullYear() into me
on click put 'in ' + (new Date(2020, 0, 15)).getFullYear() + '!' into me
on click put new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US').format(1234.5) into me
on click set d to new Date(1999, 5, 1) then put d.getFullYear() into me
on click set t to new Date(2020, 0, 15).getDay() then put t into me
on click set m to new Map() then put m into me
on click set d to new Date() then put d into me
on click toggle #x then put 'done' into me
